scenario_construction.base_residuals: For historical dayi>=Jan2 compute own past-only4weekday/7day reference forecast, eL=Lactual-Lhat, ePV=Vhat-Vactual in kW. Keep signed full144slot shapes.
scenario_construction.episodes: BeginFeb1 and every14days thereafter; each lasts3days, followed by11normal-forecast days. Fixed diagnostic calendar, not estimated event frequency. No inventory reset at episodes.
scenario_construction.donor_availability: At episode startd select a block of3 consecutive complete observed days within [max(1,d-28),d); all donoractual and donorforecasthistory precede d. Selection is shared across two policies, from unperturbed reference residuals, not dependent on their cost.
scenario_construction.donor_rule: For load require positive sum eL;PV positive sum ePV;joint both positive, preserve same dates and full paired shapes. Score integrated selected component(s) across72h. Sort eligible blocks by(score,start_day); choose nearest-rank90th percentile ceil(0.9*n)-1. If no eligible block use zero perturbation and record it. No multiplying errors or per-slot sign clipping.
scenario_construction.input_change: During an episode, use successive donor day shapes. Lhat_stress=max(0,Lhat-eL) for active load component and Vhat_stress=max(0,Vhat+ePV) for activePV; otherwise unperturbed. Apply current donor-day shape to both24h forecast horizons without future truth. PV stays0 at clock slots with no positive actualPV in preceding28days. Record raw and clipped realized changes; episode score positive does not mean every slot/day is adverse.
scenario_construction.error_update: Jan reference residuals initialize history. FromFeb1 each scenario stores errors between actual and its own previously issued perturbed first-day forecasts only after that day completes. Both policies see identical errors; only quantile weighting differs. Never use unperturbed postFeb errors for a perturbed policy.
scenario_construction.interpretation: Controlled forecast-input disturbance under shared original actual background; compounded on existing prediction errors. Donor blocks are observed but synthetic re-use calendar is artificial. Tests this scenario family, not true weather frequency, independent future-year performance or probabilistic reliability.
